title: The Interlopers

teacherSummary.text: In a Carpathian forest on a stormy winter night, Ulrich von Gradwitz and Georg Znaeym, heirs to a generations-old land feud, meet while each hunts the other. A falling beech pins them both. Trapped, they make peace and plan to be friends, and shout for their men. Figures approach through the trees. Ulrich sees what they are: 'Wolves.'

My answer: The final word, "Wolves," means the two men will die together; their reconciliation comes too late, and nature, which does not care about their feud, turns their land quarrel into a deadly irony.
